name: Lobby Warmup
prompts: The snack table just became a negotiation about _____.

My contribution to team bonding tonight is _____.
The elevator small talk took a hard left into _____.
If this hang had a mascot, it would be _____.

I almost stayed home because of _____.
The unofficial dress code tonight is _____.
When the playlist skips, the room gets _____.
My honest reason for showing up: _____.
The host said "one more round" and then _____.

The whiteboard in the corner somehow says _____.
We were fine until someone mentioned _____.

The best seat in the room comes with _____.
If HR walked in right now, they'd find _____.

Someone just offered me _____. I said yes.
